statements.quote: In the fourth quarter, we grew revenue in all of our segments, driven by continued adoption of our hybrid cloud and AI offerings.
statements.notes: Total revenue growth (Q4 2023) attributed partly to AI offerings, jointly with hybrid cloud; no AI revenue amount or share stated. The adjacent claim that the watsonx/generative AI book of business 'roughly doubled' is bookings growth, not revenue, so it is not recorded.

statements.quote: Throughout 2023, those strengths enabled us to increase our investment in R&D and talent, and complete nine acquisitions to bolster our hybrid cloud and AI capabilities, all while continuing to return value to shareholders through our dividend.
statements.notes: Ambiguous: 'to bolster our hybrid cloud and AI capabilities' most directly modifies the acquisitions, not the increased R&D and talent investment; the link of R&D/headcount spend to AI is weak and unquantified.

none_found.reason: no sentence links capital expenditures to AI; p03 only defines free cash flow, including net capital expenditures
